title: random
text:
random

Maria: Quick check — sunset patio watch tomorrow for the playoff OT? 7:00pm start, projector + pizza. Also, tiny admin: need a fantasy trade veto vote today (Tom -> Lisa trade).
Kevin: Count me in for pizza :pizza: I'll bring speakers.
Danielle: Ugh meeting til 8, can't make the patio. Veto the trade — seems lopsided. :grimacing:
Alex: I can bring an HDMI dongle. RSVP me as +1. Also NY vs LA — I'm on Team NY.
Kevin: Taco side-bet? Loser buys tacos. :taco: Low stakes only.
Maria: Done, taco bet accepted. Also vote on the league app before EOD please. I'll post link in #random an hour before kick.
Danielle: Vote: VETO. Post the trade screenshot if someone has it.
Alex: Screenshot posted: ```
Trade proposal:
- Tom receives: RB J. Harris, WR M. Cole
- Lisa receives: 2026 2nd round pick
Reason: Tom's playoff push; Lisa retools for next season.
```
Kevin: That looks rotten for the league parity. I'm voting veto too.
watch-bot: Reminder set: "Patio playoff watch" at 19:00 tomorrow in #random. Bring chargers.
Maria: Perfect. HDMI + speakers + pizza locked. I'll ping the stream link 1h prior. :thumbsup:
Kevin: If anyone can't make patio, we can also open up a Zoom for late arrivals.
Danielle: Appreciate that. I'll tune in if I can't come in person. Good luck with the tacos :sweat_smile:
